# components/tour

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.ts from components/tour/tour.ts — edit the source, then `deno task docs`. -->

Import: `import { Tour } from "@tundralibs/ui/tour"`

Rendered in every variant on the catalogue (`deno task build:demos`, then `demo/index.html`). Guides: [Getting started](../UI-Getting-Started.md) · [rAPId integration](../UI-Rapid.md) · [Theming](../UI-Theming.md).

## Functions

### `Tour`

```ts
Tour(props: TourProps): Html
```

A guided walk through a page: one card at a time, pointed at an element
through a spotlight cut from a page scrim. The steps are rendered up
front (hidden); tour.js shows one, scrolls its target into view,
places the card with shared/js/float.js, traps Tab inside it, moves on
with Next or →, back with Back or ←, ends with Done, Skip or Escape
(focus returns to what started it). It fires `tour:step` ({ index,
total, target }) on each step and `tour:done` ({ completed }) at the end.
A tour is script-only by nature: without JS nothing shows and the start
button does nothing.

## Types

### `TourPlacement`

Where the card sits relative to the step's target; flipped by the script when there is no room.

- `"top"`
- `"bottom"`
- `"start"`
- `"end"`

### `TourStart`

`load`: starts on page load (once, when `storageKey` says it has not been finished); `manual`: a `[data-tour-start]` starts it.

- `"load"`
- `"manual"`

### `TourStep`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | `string` |  | CSS selector of the element this step points at; none → the card is centred. |
| `title` | `string | Html` | yes |  |
| `body` | `string | Html` | yes |  |
| `placement` | `TourPlacement` |  |  |

### `TourProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Required: `data-tour-start="#<id>"` on any element starts it. |
| `steps` | `TourStep[]` | yes |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the dialog. @default "Tour" |
| `startOn` | `TourStart` |  |  |
| `storageKey` | `string` |  | A `localStorage` key under which finishing (or skipping) is recorded, so a `load` tour runs once per browser. Omit it and a `load` tour runs on every visit. |
| `progress` | `string` |  | Text of the progress line; `{n}` and `{total}` are filled. @default "{n} of {total}" |
| `labels` | `{ skip?: string; back?: string; next?: string; done?: string }` |  | Button labels. |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### A first-run tour that plays once

`startOn: "load"` starts it when the page is ready; `storageKey` records that it was finished or skipped so it does not come back. Each step points at an element by selector — a step whose target is not on the page is skipped.

```ts
Tour({
  id: "first-run",
  startOn: "load",
  storageKey: "tour:first-run",
  label: "Welcome tour",
  steps: [
    { target: "#new-project", title: "Create a project", body: "Everything starts here." },
    { target: "#search", placement: "end", title: "Find anything", body: "Or press ⌘K anywhere." },
    { title: "That is it", body: "Replay this tour from the help menu at any time." },
  ],
})
```

```html
<div class="tour" id="first-run" hidden="" data-tour="" data-tour-start-on="load" data-tour-key="tour:first-run">
  <div class="tour__scrim" data-tour-scrim></div>
  <div class="tour__spot" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="tour__card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Welcome tour" tabindex="-1">
    <ol class="tour__steps">
      <li class="tour__step" data-tour-step="" data-target="#new-project" data-placement="bottom" hidden="" id="first-run-step-1">
        <h3 class="tour__title" id="first-run-step-1-title">Create a project</h3>
        <div class="tour__body">Everything starts here.</div>
      </li>
      <li class="tour__step" data-tour-step="" data-target="#search" data-placement="end" hidden="" id="first-run-step-2">
        <h3 class="tour__title" id="first-run-step-2-title">Find anything</h3>
        <div class="tour__body">Or press ⌘K anywhere.</div>
      </li>
      <li class="tour__step" data-tour-step="" data-placement="bottom" hidden="" id="first-run-step-3">
        <h3 class="tour__title" id="first-run-step-3-title">That is it</h3>
        <div class="tour__body">Replay this tour from the help menu at any time.</div>
      </li>
    </ol>
    <div class="tour__footer">
      <span class="tour__progress" data-tour-progress data-template="{n} of {total}"></span>
      <div class="tour__actions">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn--ghost btn--sm" data-tour-skip>Skip</button>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn--outline btn--sm" data-tour-back>Back</button>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn--sm" data-tour-next data-next-label="Next" data-done-label="Done">Next</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

### Replay it from a help menu

Any element with `data-tour-start="#<id>"` starts the tour; focus returns to it at the end.

```ts
html`
  ${Button({ label: "Take the tour", variant: "ghost", attrs: { "data-tour-start": "#first-run" } })}
`
```

```html
<button type="button" class="btn btn--ghost" data-tour-start="#first-run">Take the tour</button>
```

## CSS hooks

Classes defined by `components/tour/tour.css` — structural, token-driven; override from an unlayered stylesheet (see [Theming](../UI-Theming.md)):

`.tour`, `.tour__actions`, `.tour__body`, `.tour__card`, `.tour__footer`, `.tour__progress`, `.tour__scrim`, `.tour__spot`, `.tour__step`, `.tour__steps`, `.tour__title`

## Behaviour

`components/tour/tour.js` ships in `ui.js` (delegated on `document`, re-initialised after a rAPId swap).

Attributes it reads or writes: `data-done-label`, `data-next-label`, `data-placement`, `data-target`, `data-template`, `data-tour`, `data-tour-back`, `data-tour-key`, `data-tour-next`, `data-tour-progress`, `data-tour-skip`, `data-tour-start`, `data-tour-start-on`, `data-tour-started`, `data-tour-step`.

Events: `rapid:swapped`, `tour:done`, `tour:step`.
